thread:
maria: Quick Q3 OKR check — can each owner drop one-line status for their milestone: shipped / slipped / partial + any blocker? Please ping reviewers if you need CR help.

sam: Adaptive-routing milestone: partial. Core routing merged to staging, canary running. Shipped the policy engine, still finishing rollout dashboard. Need one more CR for the fallback policy PR (https://git.redwood/rr/adaptive-routing/pull/412).

dave: KV-cache v2: slipped. Performance regression on long-tail sequences after quantization tests. Repro is here: `bench/kv_v2/regression.log`. Debugging with infra now, ETA for fix ~EOD Fri.

priya: Embeddings-batching opt: shipped. Saw ~18% cost reduction on beta workload. Follow-on: add per-tenant batch caps in next sprint.

noah: Dedicated autoscale policy: partial. Autoscaler prototype works for pooled GPUs but failing stability tests under burst; tying to SRE test harness. Blocker: need a small quota bump in staging to run full soak — @maria can you approve?

maria: approved quota bump for staging for the soak. Also, prioritize Dave's perf regression — that blocks several rollouts.

sam: FYI deploy-bot reports: deployed adaptive-routing canary to us-west, traffic at ~5%.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: adaptive-routing:v2 -> us-west (5%). No errors in last 30m.

dave: thanks — allocating time with infra tomorrow morning 10am PT to root-cause. Will post findings.

priya: small ask — can someone from infra review https://git.redwood/rr/embeddings/pull/88? It's 1 file, perf-safe, just needs a second pair of eyes. @dave?

dave: will review after the 10am debug.

maria: Next steps summary: 1) Dave fixes/regresses KV-cache v2 (owner: dave, ETA: Fri EOD) 2) Sam finishes fallback policy CR & merge (owner: sam, ETA: Thu) 3) Noah and SRE run autoscale soak (owner: noah+eng-sre, ETA: next week) 4) Priya follow-up batch caps (owner: priya, ETA: next quarter). If anything slips, list impact and proposed mitigation.

sam: quick note — if kv-cache fix takes >2d we can rollback v2 and keep routing canary limited to short sequences.

dave: noted. If rollback needed I'll coordinate a rapid revert PR.

priya: marking embeddings-batching as shipped in OKR tracker (linked in the doc).

maria: thanks team. If you need CR nudges drop them here and I'll ping eng leads. :thumbsup:

noah: queued autoscaler soak tickets and added staging quota request (jira/RR-1123).

sam: pinging @alice (ops) for extra eyeballs on fallback policy later today.

maria: closing the async check — please update the OKR board with final states by EOD Friday.

noah: last message — if anyone sees increased p99 from routing canary call out here so we can rollback fast.
